note: SNG-064 LAW 10 — the manifest is a LOAD WHITELIST. A file not listed here DOES NOT EXIST. RESOLUTION: they are correctly KNOWN_UNLOADED and stay registered - SNG-064 requires any file on disk in rules/ to be manifest-whitelisted, so deregistering-in-place isn't valid (it makes them on-disk-but-not-whitelisted). Neither is a true gap. FOLLOW-ON (Aevi's call, not this turn): move the 4 pure design docs out of content/packs/core/rules/ into a docs/ location so they're not claimed as rules at all - a bigger move than the ratchet needs today.
